ambiguities: A-AGENCY-01: observed choice versus legal capacity versus reported control; legal/norm division unresolved and must be upstream.
A-AGENCY-02: agency:Participant children Volitional,Patient,Experiencer are currently disjoint; the same person may enact multiple perspectives,so do not inherit that disjointness without review.
A-AGENCY-03: existing agency:Decision claims intentional mental activity; no axiom that every transformation has a decision or vice versa.
A-AGENCY-04: authorization and representation need scope/content; neither a binary unqualified relation nor a free-text model variable supplies that missing meaning.
A-AGENCY-05: artificial and nonhuman agency remain outside these human sources; no silent universalization.
